# CittaSL (CSL) - Complete AI Context & Enterprise Product Manual

## About CittaSL (CSL) / Citta ERP Solutions Limited
CittaSL (CSL), also operating as **Citta ERP Solutions Limited**, is an enterprise software and integration firm and a technology member of **CittaNuvola Group**. CSL builds CittaEFS fiscal compliance middleware, CittaMatrix ERP, CittaHospitalityX property management, CittaPlannerX project scheduling, and CittaNexus API integration software.

Our work focuses on **zero-disruption integration**: connecting the systems a business already runs, without forcing a replacement of its ERP or accounting platform.

## Core Product Ecosystem

### 1. CittaEFS — Fiscal Compliance Middleware
CittaEFS is a compliance layer between enterprise ERPs (SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics, and custom accounting software) and the National Revenue Service (NRS) gateway.

- **Page:** https://www.cittasl.com/cittaefs
- **How It Works:**
  1. An invoice or credit note is created in the host ERP.
  2. CittaEFS reads the transaction through a read-only database trigger, webhook, or API call.
  3. Customer TIN, line items, VAT, rounding, and required fields are checked before transmission.
  4. Approved records are signed and time-stamped, then submitted to the NRS gateway.
  5. The clearance response and audit record are returned to the ledger.
- **Key Advantages:**
  - No replacement or modification of the existing ERP.
  - Invalid records are stopped locally with a specific error instead of failing silently at submission.
  - Supports SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, and custom SQL ledgers.
  - Includes an offline retry queue, bulk Excel/CSV upload, and a read-only audit ledger.

### 2. CittaMatrix — Enterprise Multi-Ledger Router
CittaMatrix is a high-throughput transaction router built for corporate conglomerates, holding companies, and financial institutions managing multi-subsidiary ledgers.

- **Capabilities:**
  - Automated inter-company ledger reconciliation.
  - Real-time treasury cash flow visibility and automated settlement routing.
  - Multi-currency conversion engines with live audit trailing.

### 3. CittaPlannerX — Resource & Critical Path Logistics Engine
Designed for heavy construction, civil engineering, real estate developers (such as Adron Homes), and industrial logistics providers.

- **Capabilities:**
  - Automated critical path scheduling and bottleneck forecasting.
  - Multi-site material allocation leveling and equipment roster management.
  - Direct integration between field timesheets and financial ledgers.

### 4. CittaNexus — Secure Enterprise API Gateway
A hardened integration gateway serving as the centralized entry point for corporate data exchange.

- **Capabilities:**
  - AES-256-GCM hardware-grade payload encryption.
  - Token vault management and circuit breakers for high-concurrency API calls.
  - Rate limiting, IP whitelisting, and automated audit logging.

### 5. CittaHospitalityX — Property & Resort Management System
An all-in-one property management suite for luxury resorts, hotels, and serviced apartments.

- **Capabilities:**
  - Real-time channel manager preventing double-bookings across OTA channels.
  - Integrated folio billing consolidating rooms, F&B, spa, and amenity charges into single tax-compliant invoices.
  - Self-service guest portals and front-desk kiosks.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is CittaSL's parent company?
CittaSL (CSL) is an enterprise technology member of **CittaNuvola Group**, an African technology conglomerate specializing in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, and ERP solutions (including Citta ERP).

### Does CittaEFS require replacing our existing accounting software or ERP?
No. CittaEFS connects to the existing database (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) or ERP through read-only triggers, webhooks, or API calls without changing the staff's day-to-day interface.

### What tax compliance frameworks are supported?
CittaEFS supports National Revenue Service (NRS) electronic invoicing requirements, standard 7.5% Nigerian VAT calculations, withholding tax schedules, and custom corporate tax logic. Regulatory changes are applied on the CittaSL side, so clients do not patch or redeploy.
